name: POS Cancel Order History
description: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale with the ability to cancel orders by providing a reason. Keep a detailed history of all canceled orders for better tracking, accountability, and manager control.
summary: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale with a smart cancellation workflow. This module allows cashiers to cancel orders only by providing a valid reason, ensuring every cancellation is properly documented. A dedicated history menu gives managers full visibility into canceled orders, including details such as who canceled, when, and why. With this added control, businesses can improve accountability, reduce errors, and maintain a transparent POS environment. The POS Cancel Order History module for Odoo 18 solves this problem by introducing a smart and transparent workflow for order cancellations in the Point of Sale system. Whenever a cashier cancels an order, the system prompts them to enter a cancellation reason through a popup window. This ensures that every cancellation is properly documented. A dedicated Cancel Order History menu allows managers and administrators to view all canceled orders in one place. From this menu, you can quickly access details such as the order reference, the responsible user, the cancellation reason, and the exact date and time of cancellation. name: POS Fix Discount
description: This app will enable order-based discounts instead of product-based either in the percentage or in amount. Till now with default functionality, users can only apply discounts on products which can be time-consuming.
summary: The POS Order Discount module for Odoo allows you to apply discounts on the entire order instead of individual products. Discounts can be applied either as a percentage or a fixed amount, saving time and simplifying the checkout process. This feature streamlines discount management and improves efficiency for businesses running Odoo POS. Simplify discount management in your Odoo Point of Sale with the POS Fix Discount Module. By default, Odoo only supports product-level discounts, which can be time-consuming for cashiers. This module enhances the checkout experience by allowing order-level discounts, enabling staff to apply discounts to the entire order either as a percentage or a fixed amount. With its intuitive interface, cashiers can apply discounts quickly and accurately, ensuring a faster checkout and a smoother sales process. Whether used for promotions, loyalty rewards, or special offers, this module eliminates repetitive work and provides a flexible discounting solution for your business. Seamlessly integrated into Odoo POS, it boosts sales efficiency, reduces errors, and improves customer satisfaction, making it ideal for retail stores, supermarkets, and restaurants. name: Employee Checklist
description:
Employee Checklist
    ==================

    This module provides a robust onboarding tracker for employees, showcasing their progress as a percentage. The checklist functionality allows HR or managers to set up and monitor specific tasks that need to be completed during an employee's entry process.

    Key Features:
    - Configurable Checklist:
      Define and customize onboarding tasks under Employee > Configurations.

    - Progress Tracking:
      Real-time tracking of onboarding progress using a percentage progress bar.

    - Multi-View Support:

name: Remove/Hide Taxes
description:
The 'Remove Taxes' module allows users to hide or remove tax fields in various Odoo documents, including sales orders, purchase orders, customer invoices, and vendor bills. This module also removes tax information from related PDF reports, giving users the ability to streamline documents without showing tax details.

    Features:
    - Toggle the visibility of tax fields in sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor bills.
    - Remove taxes from the generated PDF reports for sales, purchases, invoices, and bills.
    - Quick and simple configuration to enable or disable tax visibility on specific document types.
    
    Benefits:
    - Simplifies document presentation by removing tax fields when not needed.
    - Provides flexibility in customizing documents and reports for different user needs.
    - Allows easy configuration via settings for each document type (sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, and bills).
    
    Navigation:
    - Users can enable or disable the tax visibility feature via the settings in Sales, Purchase, and Invoicing configurations.
    - Once enabled, taxes will be hidden from the form views as well as from the generated PDF reports.

name: Sale order multiple pricelist
description:
The Sale Multiple Pricelist app allows users to assign multiple pricelists to individual products within a sale order, making it easy to customize pricing for each item. The app features an "Apply" button that facilitates quick pricelist selection and automatically updates the product prices accordingly.

        Key Features:
        1) Product-Specific Pricelist Application:
           - Choose specific pricelists for products directly within the sale order to easily update product prices.

        2) Wizard Selection for Pricelist Application:
           - Select a product in a sale order and use the "Apply" button to choose from available pricelists, updating the product price instantly.

        3) Easy Pricelist Assignment:
           - Create new pricelists and assign them to products as needed, offering a flexible pricing strategy for each sale.
